claims.quote: Renewables reached 16.9% of Israel's electricity in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015

SELECT 100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN renewables_share_elec END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2015 THEN renewables_share_elec END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2015 THEN renewables_share_elec END) FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel'
SELECT coal_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025

SELECT 100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN electricity_generation END) - MIN(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN electricity_generation END)) / MIN(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN electricity_generation END) FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel'
claims.note: query uses year 2010, which the claim's sentence doesn't state or imply

claims.sql: SELECT electricity_generation FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
